en-US: Stream a long answer and scroll through the conversation. Reopen a task that created a timer and check that each timer appears once in its own answer. Check that a document assistant's title and status still update in the task list. Paste a long mixed-language draft. In a large workspace, filter a directory by name and move between result pages.
zh-Hans: 生成长回复，在流式输出时滚动会话。重开曾创建定时器的任务，检查每个定时器只在所属回复中出现一次。检查文件助手的标题和状态有变化时，任务列表仍会更新。粘贴一段中英文混排的长文本。在大工作区按名称筛选目录并翻页。
